name: Resistance / Muscular Training
definition: Exercises using external or bodyweight resistance to develop muscular fitness.

name: Cardiorespiratory Training
definition: Continuous or intermittent work primarily targeting cardiorespiratory fitness.

name: Power / Explosive Training
definition: Training emphasizing force production at high movement velocity.

name: Plyometric Training
definition: Explosive stretch-shortening-cycle jumps, hops, bounds, and throws.

name: Speed / Sprint Training
definition: Training to improve acceleration and maximal movement speed.

name: Agility / Change-of-Direction
definition: Planned or reactive acceleration, deceleration, and direction change.

name: Mobility Training
definition: Active movement through usable ranges of motion.

name: Flexibility / Stretching
definition: Training designed to maintain or increase passive/active range of motion.

name: Core / Trunk Training
definition: Training trunk force production, transfer, and stability.

name: Functional / Integrated Training
definition: Multi-joint or task-oriented movement integrating multiple regions.

name: Metabolic Conditioning
definition: Mixed exercise arranged to challenge work capacity and energy systems.

name: Recovery / Regeneration
definition: Low-intensity activity, mobility, and tissue-care sessions supporting recovery.

name: Sport-Specific Training
definition: Training designed around demands of a particular sport.

name: Fitness Testing / Assessment
definition: Structured tests used to establish baselines and monitor progress.
